description: Liveness, readiness and startup probes of the container. Does **not** apply to `initContainers`. See [probes](/truecharts-common/container/probes).

liveness.description: Liveness probe. When it fails, Kubernetes restarts the container. See [probe](/truecharts-common/container/probe).

readiness.description: Readiness probe. While it fails, the pod is removed from the endpoints of Services. See [probe](/truecharts-common/container/probe).

startup.description: Startup probe. The other probes wait until it succeeds, which is useful for slow starting apps. See [probe](/truecharts-common/container/probe).
